note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the declared HS 901811 (electrocardiographs) and the claimed industry "Нефтегаз и химия" (oil & gas / chemicals) both conflict with the observed trade profile. The actual customs rows show the company importing inkjet/photo paper (HS 48115190), liquid ink (HS 32151190) and medical X-ray dry film (HS 37011010 / 37021000) from Chinese suppliers (United Imatek Qingdao, Ninestar Image Tech, Nanyang Jiuding, Shenzhen Flash Digital, Huizhou Yidu) through Nhava Sheva Sea — i.e. it is a trader/distributor of imaging consumables and X-ray film, not an ECG manufacturer and not an oil/gas or chemicals supplier. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (37011010 / 37021000 / 48115190 / 32151190) and the industry field corrected away from oil & gas/chemicals. Role: trader (imports for Indian resale); no manufacturing or export evidence seen. Address on record: "B1-2, SAI NAGAR, NEAR RAILWAY CROSSING". Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any retrieved source, not estimated. Two slug variants were tried: 'vinod-medical-systems-private-limited' (3292 records, populated) and 'vinod-medical-systems-pvt-ltd' plus 'vinod-medical-systems' (both empty shells, no rows) — so the record set attaches to the PRIVATE LIMITED legal form only. Caveat: only 5 of 3292 rows were visible on the free tier, so an export leg cannot be positively excluded from the unseen 3287 rows; export_status is therefore 'none_found' (nothing seen) rather than a proven negative.
